text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein congratulates Jordanians on the advent of the Moslem feast of Eid al Adha; receives good wishes from leaders of Moslem world and neigbouring countries.
- King Hussein sends condolences to Saudi King Fahd on the victims of the Haj fire in Mecca; praise for Saudi efforts to contain the disaster which killed 343 pilgrims.
- Jordan signs European Union partnership association accord; the accord pledges economic aid to Jordan, setting up a reciprocal free trade zone and comprehensive cooperation.
- Foreign Minister Fayez Tarawnah and his Syrian counterpart discuss ties between the two states during a meeting on the sidelines of the Malta conference.
- Sudan praises King Hussein's supportive stand alongside it in its fight against rebel attacks.
- Jordan-EU initial partnership deal to be implemented in 1999.
